notes: System Architect technical-design skill (SDLC Stage 3b). Evaluate by checking it detects the tech stack, designs ORM schema + endpoints + services + DTOs, and writes docs/specs/detail-design/TECH-[feature].md with auth guards, pagination, and N+1 handling; positives should fire, the implementation boundary should route to implement-feature.

evals.prompt: Design the API endpoints and ORM schema for the order module.
evals.expected_output: Reads PROJECT.md/CLAUDE.md for the ORM and framework, then writes docs/specs/detail-design/TECH-order.md: ORM models/relations/indexes, module structure, controller routes with auth + role guards, service method signatures, DTOs/validators, error handling, pagination on list endpoints, and N+1 mitigation. Does not write real code.

evals.prompt: Write the technical design for the product catalog feature from its SRS.
evals.expected_output: Consumes docs/specs/requirements/SRS-product-catalog.md, designs schema + endpoints + services following detected stack conventions, and produces docs/specs/detail-design/TECH-product-catalog.md passing the checklist (soft delete/audit cols, guards + OpenAPI docs, validators, pagination, eager loading).

evals.prompt: Go ahead and implement the order module controllers and services in code.
evals.expected_output: Should route to implement-feature / not fire, because this asks to write the actual code, whereas design-function only produces the TECH design spec.
